settings.notes: fee_percent_* = everything Shopee takes as a % of the price (commission + programme service fee + transaction fee). fixed_fee_per_order = flat fees (MY platform fee RM0.54, SG seller shipping share). fees_from: 'real orders' or 'fee table'.

notes: products: {"product", "price", "cost", "left_before_ads", "margin_percent", "break_even_roas"} — cost = what one unit costs you to buy or make, delivered to you. The last three are worked out by Claude.
